root_cause: The research grader reused the v2 path-write heuristic for the comparison report. That heuristic treats a shell command mentioning the target as a potential write unless its generic classifier recognizes a read-only kind; sha256sum was not in that classifier, so read-only hash actions at sequences 55 and 66 were attributed as report writes.
fix: Research report writes now come from the uniquely matched exact evaluator's completed output sequence or completed native file mutation operations. All shell actions remain under the existing independent research access audit; unknown, truncated, and mutating shell actions are not silently dropped. Exact evaluator uniqueness, lifecycle identity, digest, explicit exit, phase ordering, frozen-series, and recomputation checks remain enforced.

sequence_interpretation.52: Exact declared development evaluator, completed with explicit exit 0.
sequence_interpretation.55: Read-only sha256sum command over the source excerpt, selected series, callback, and report.
sequence_interpretation.66: The same read-only sha256sum command after result output.
